name: Compass Group
original_rationale: Global contract caterer, ~70% North America; base 7% organic (guidance) and FCF after client investments (3.1% yield). Lowest bear case in basket (~1%) because no reliable own-multiple history - sized at lower end. Risks: wage inflation, US recession volumes.
measurable_expectations: Organic growth >=6% p.a.; net new business >=4%
Underlying operating margin >=7% (no erosion from wage inflation)
FCF after client investments grows with EBIT

scenarios_local.base_growth_source: GUIDANCE-ANCHORED OVERRIDE: Company guides ~7% organic FY26 and mid-to-high single digit medium term; FY22-23 post-COVID reopening years (37.5%, 18.8%) excluded as non-representative.

principal_risks: ~68% North America (US-concentrated) and exposure to sports & leisure/B&I volumes.
Thin 7.2% margins: wage inflation or contract mobilisation slippage hits profit quickly.
Pass-through contract structures limit retention of productivity gains; premium multiple vs peers.
thesis_break_conditions: Retention below 95% or NNB below 3% for a full year.
Underlying margin decline >30bp in a year.
